Restore Wellness Physiotherapy & Rehab Center offers professional physiotherapy and rehabilitation services tailored to support your recovery, strength, and overall wellness. Whether you're dealing with injury, chronic pain, or post-surgery recovery, our expert therapists provide personalized treatment plans to help you regain mobility and improve your quality of life. 

Visit us at:
FB Area Branch: 639 Azizabad Main Rd, Block 8, Federal B Area, Karachi Sindh Pakistan

For appointments, contact us on:
WhatsApp: 0314-8000440
Phone: 0336-2500862
